text:
emily.p: Quick follow-up from the PM — we need a consumer-friendly status blurb, a concise 72h customer digest, and an "RCA access matrix" (who gets full RCA + redaction rules). Also assign remediation owners and tag recurring-patterns for tracking.

ben: I can do the public blurb. One short para + apology + link to follow-up.

harpreet: I'll draft the 72h digest skeleton (timeline, measured impact, mitigations, recurrence cadence) and include a short "what you'll see" section.

legal: We'll produce a redaction rubric and an access matrix. Anything with customer IDs, hostnames, or raw request logs needs sign-off or NDA.

support-lead: I'll build the impacted-customer list and map outreach owners; Dedicated customers get proactive outreach.

emily.p: OK let's lock owners and deadlines. Post AIs and react with :thumbsup: to accept.

```
AI-501: Ben          - Draft public status blurb by EOD today and place in Statuspage draft workspace.
AI-502: Harpreet     - Publish 72h customer digest skeleton to PM-1100 within 72h (include recurrence cadence & short runbook proposals).
AI-503: Legal        - Deliver redaction rubric + RCA access matrix by +48h.
AI-504: Support-Lead - Produce impacted-customer CSV and assign outreach owners by EOD today.
AI-505: Emily.P      - Add AIs to PM-1100, set dates, confirm final approver for public copy.
```

support-lead: Accept AI-504. I'll tag owners and upload CSV by 17:00 UTC.

harpreet: Accept AI-502. I'll include a small "what we won't include" bullet referencing Legal's rubric. Also a short recurrence section: two similar failovers in last 10 days, suggesting a 30-day follow-up cadence.

ben: Accept AI-501. Draft blurb below — short and consumer-friendly: 

"We experienced intermittent API errors between 03:1204:05 UTC caused by a database failover. Some requests returned 5xx errors; normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after traffic rerouting. We apologize for the disruption. A concise customer summary and next steps will be published within 72 hours: <status-link>."

legal: We'll draft the redaction rubric. Quick rule: no hostnames/IPs, no customer-identifiable IDs, no raw request dumps. Full RCA can be shared to named customer contacts after Support+Legal approval and NDA if required.

emily.p: Good. Harpreet, include a brief "recurrence mitigation proposal" in the 72h digest so Ops can pick it up for next sprint. Support-Lead, once you upload the CSV, tag the customers who should receive the digest proactively.

ops-bot: Reminder: add AI-501..AI-505 to ticket PM-1100 with due dates.

support-lead: CSV uploaded and owners assigned. Marking AI-504 accepted in ticket.

harpreet: 72h digest skeleton uploaded to PM-1100: timeline, impact numbers, mitigation steps, recurrence cadence, and two runbook proposals (CB backoff + post-failover health check). Will redact per Legal before publishing.

legal: Redaction rubric posted to PM-1100. Draft RCA access matrix attached. Please route any customer RCA requests via Support for Legal review.

emily.p: Thanks all. Final check: Ben post the public blurb to the Statuspage draft and ping me for approval. If anyone can't hit an ETA, update here so we can reassign.

ben: Posting now and pinging @emily.p.

emily.p: Approved. Closing loop: I'll verify PM-1100 tomorrow and confirm next steps. If recurring signals appear, call them out in this thread.

harpreet: :thumbsup"
